column3: “Administered justice” is rendered “performed acts of righteousness.”
“Blades” is rendered “edge,” and “be empowered” “were made strong.”
NASB adds “their”; “not having accepted” is rendered “not accepting.”
NASB includes “they were tempted,” which is in the Textus Receptus but not in the critical text; “oppressed” is rendered “afflicted.”
NASB puts the first clause in parentheses and supplies “men.”
“Commended” is rendered “gained approval,” and “the promise” “what was promised.”
